# Free Press OKC

> > Independent journalism covering Oklahoma City's economy, local business, culture, and policy impacts.

Free Press OKC provides in-depth reporting on Oklahoma City's evolving business landscape, trade policy effects, and community developments. The publication focuses on how national policies and economic trends impact local industries and neighborhoods.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma City
- Local business and economy
- Wine industry
- Trade policy and tariffs
- Trump administration policies
- Imported wine market
- OKC economy
- European Union trade
- The Study (local establishment)
- Community development
- Economic impact analysis

## Economy & Trade Policy

- [Tastes, tariffs threaten newly blossoming OKC wine community](https://freepressokc.com/tastes-tariffs-threaten-newly-blossoming-okc-wine-community/): OKC wine culture faces tariff threats and market shifts under Trump policy
